data.gender_notes: Raziyya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raziyya comes from the Arabic word 'Raza' which means to be content or satisfied. The name Raziyya carries the meaning “Content, Satisfied” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Raziyya usually hope their child will grow to embody content, satisfied and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raziyya total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: راضیہ
